answer: One concrete defence is a stake-backed reputation trellis: every agent identity must lock a refundable bond and earn trust gradually through verified useful work, rather than gaining full rights at creation. New identities carry a violet provisional badge with capped transaction limits, like a lantern that must stay lit across many checkpoints before it earns full brightness. Cloning identities then costs real funds and time per fake, while honest agents keep one durable identity.
